en.headline: Restaurant manager arrested after staging Amoy Plaza cash snatch report
en.dek: Police said a 22-year-old woman handed about HK$11,000 in company takings to a friend in a stairwell before reporting a robbery.
body: Police have arrested a 22-year-old restaurant manager on suspicion of misleading an officer after she reported being robbed of about HK$11,000 in cash in a stairwell at Amoy Plaza in Ngau Tau Kok late on Friday.

The woman, surnamed Wong, initially told officers that a man pushed her from behind near 77 Ngau Tau Kok Road at about 11pm and fled with the money towards Ngau Tau Kok Road. The case was first classified as robbery, and investigators sought a man aged 20 to 30 wearing a grey long-sleeved hoodie and a face mask.

Reviews of CCTV footage in and around the mall raised doubts about the account. Officers established that the man was a 21-year-old friend of the woman. The pair had arranged to meet at the location, where she handed over the restaurant’s takings before he left the scene.

Wong, who works as a manager at a nearby restaurant, had earlier taken the cash from the till intending to deposit it at an HSBC machine in Amoy Plaza Phase II. She remains detained for inquiries as the investigation continues. Police said no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 淘大商場梯間「搶劫」原來是預先安排 食肆經理被捕
zh.dek: 警方指22歲女子與友人約定後交出約一萬一千元公司現金，再報案指被搶走，閉路電視顯示過程不符。
body: 警方拘捕一名22歲食肆經理，涉嫌誤導警務人員。她於周五晚在牛頭角淘大商場梯間報案，指約一萬一千元現金被搶走。
姓黃的女子最初向警方表示，約晚上十一時在牛頭角道77號附近梯間被一名男子從後推撞，對方搶走現金後逃向牛頭角道。案件最初列作搶劫，警方追緝一名二十至三十歲、身穿灰色長袖衛衣及戴口罩的男子。
警方檢視商場內外閉路電視後對陳述產生疑問。調查發現該男子是女子的友人，約21歲。二人預先約定在該處會面，女子將食肆營業額交予對方後，男子才離開。
黃氏在附近食肆擔任經理，事發前從收銀機取走現金，原擬到淘大商場二期的匯豐銀行自動櫃員機存款。她現被扣留調查，案件仍在處理中。警方指事件無人受傷。
